ideas.name: Cross-asset carry: long high, short low carry
ideas.claim: Carry (expected return with unchanged prices) predicts returns in the cross section and time series across many asset classes, including currencies; long high-carry and short low-carry securities.
ideas.quote: We find that carry predicts returns both in the cross section and time series for a variety of different asset classes

rules.market: currencies (also equities, bonds, commodities, credit, options)
